name: UOP Outbound Receiver — UOP → n8n (mock ServiceNow)

meta._comment: UOP LicenseOps outbound receiver (ADR-0008 線② outbound). Platform N8nWorkflowProvider POSTs here with header X-N8n-Key (build a Header Auth credential in n8n: Name=X-N8n-Key, Value=your N8N_OUTBOUND_WEBHOOK_KEY — NOT baked in). Webhook auth verifies it. Code node mocks the ServiceNow REQ + per-line RITM sysIds; Respond node returns them synchronously in CONTRACT-OUTBOUND §4 shape so the platform builds its mirror. To go live you must ACTIVATE the workflow (Production webhook URL) and, on the platform side, wire N8N_OUTBOUND_WEBHOOK_URL + N8N_OUTBOUND_WEBHOOK_KEY + REQUEST_SUBMISSION_PROVIDER=n8n. If you change the response shape, the platform provider mapping must change too. See docs/05-usage/N8N-INTEGRATION-SETUP.md 線②.
